name: [🍭UPD10] Swim to Save Princess
desc:
[Update 13 - World 7]
🌵 New world: Great Canyon. Can you imagine swim in this dry land?
🏊‍♀️ New pets, and swim gears added!


🏊‍♂️ Swim to save princess and earn coins & a shiny trophy🏊‍♂️
Tips: The further you swim, the more coins you earn!
         Buy cute pets that help you get coins faster!
         Equip cool gear to swim faster and farther!
         You will surf back if you ran out of stamina!

Challenge your friends to see who can swim the farthest!
Super fun and easy for all ages!

If you enjoy, do not forget to 👍like & join our group.
